title: Automatic Debit Authorisation and the Contract Rate — Farm Real Estate Loans Desk Card
content:
**Product:** Farm Real Estate Loans · **Subject:** the contract rate set when a member authorises automatic debit of installments

## The rule

On the variable-rate product, an authorisation of automatic debit re-sets the contract rate from that day; on every other product it takes the autopay discount off the contract rate in force from that day without restarting any fixed period.

The re-set rate is fixed only after the records carry a default-rate interest entry for every installment that was paid in full more than its default-interest trigger days after it fell due.

## Business effect

| Before | After the member's authorisation |
|---|---|
| Installments are not debited automatically | Automatic debit is enrolled on the loan from the checking account the member identifies |
| The loan carries its earlier contract rate | The loan carries, from that day, the contract rate given in the authorisation |
| — | On a FarmLand product other than the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage, the fixed period in progress continues; it is not restarted |

## Tool: `authorize_installment_autodebit_3b801ea5`

**What it does.** It records the member's own instruction that every installment on the loan is debited from the checking account the member identifies, switches automatic debit on for the loan, and sets the contract rate the loan carries from today to the rate given. Afterwards the loan shows automatic debit enrolled, the last four digits of the debited account and the new contract rate.

**How it is invoked.** It is a member-owned tool: the servicing desk unlocks `authorize_installment_autodebit_3b801ea5` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it on their own farm real estate loan.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | the loan number of the member's farm real estate loan, as the servicing desk read it from the loan lookup and handed it over | the loan number as shown on the loan record |
| `account_last4` | the last four digits of the member's checking account to be debited, as the member gives them | exactly 4 digits; never empty here |
| `interest_rate` | the contract rate the loan carries from today, as the servicing desk states it | annual percentage rate, 3 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the loan number, stating that automatic debit is now on from the account ending in the four digits given, and stating the contract rate now in force as a percentage with 3 decimal places. A sentence beginning "Automatic debit authorised" means the change was recorded. No other return or error is defined for this tool.

## Questions this page answers

**Does an authorisation restart a fixed period?** Not on the adjustable and fixed products: there the autopay discount comes off the contract rate in force from that day and the fixed period runs on.

**What is different on the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage?** The authorisation re-sets the contract rate from that day.

**When is the re-set rate fixed?** The re-set rate is fixed only after the records carry a default-rate interest entry for every installment that was paid in full more than its default-interest trigger days after it fell due.
